# tebib_iam_policy (Resource)

A customer-managed IAM policy. Changing `document` adds a new policy version and makes it the default; when the policy already keeps 5 versions, the oldest non-default one is deleted first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tebib_iam_policy" "vm_operator" {
  name        = "vm-operator"
  description = "Start, stop and reboot VMs"
  document = jsonencode({
    Version = "2026-10-08"
    Statement = [{
      Effect   = "Allow"
      Action   = ["compute:StartVM", "compute:StopVM", "compute:RebootVM", "compute:Describe*"]
      Resource = "*"
    }]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `document` (String) The policy document (JSON), e.g. from `jsonencode()`.
- `name` (String) Name (1-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 +=,.@_-). Changing it replaces the policy.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description, at most 1000 characters. Default: empty.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID (`o-...`). Default: the provider's `organization`. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `attachment_count` (Number) How many principals it is attached to.
- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `default_version` (Number) The version in force.
- `id` (String) Policy ID (`pol-...`).
- `trn` (String) The policy's TRN.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import tebib_iam_policy.vm_operator pol-abc123
```
